blocks.text: 學習《香港國安法》第 20–30 條
請仔細閱讀以下官方條文，留意加粗嘅關鍵規則；稍後會有測驗，檢查你對每條法例嘅理解。

blocks.title: 官方條文｜《香港國安法》第 20–30 條

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 20
items.textZh: 任何人組織、策劃、實施或者參與實施以下旨在分裂國家、破壞國家統一行為之一的，不論是否使用武力或者以武力相威脅，即屬犯罪： （一）將香港特別行政區或者中華人民共和國其他任何部分從中華人民共和國分離出去； （二）非法改變香港特別行政區或者中華人民共和國其他任何部分的法律地位； （三）將香港特別行政區或者中華人民共和國其他任何部分轉歸外國統治。 犯前款罪，對首要分子或者罪行重大的，處無期徒刑或者十年以上有期徒刑：對積極參加的，處三年以上十年以下有期徒刑；對其他參加的，處三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制。
items.textEn: Any person who organizes, plans, implements or participates in the implementation of any of the following acts aimed at splitting the country and undermining national unity shall be guilty of a crime, regardless of whether he or she uses force or threatens force: (1) Separating the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region or any other part of the People's Republic of China from the People's Republic of China; (2) Illegally changing the legal status of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region or any other part of the People's Republic of China; (3) Transferring the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region or any other part of the People's Republic of China to foreign rule. For those who commit the crime in the preceding paragraph, the ringleaders or those whose crimes are serious shall be sentenced to life imprisonment or fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years; those who actively participate shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years; and other participants shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 21
items.textZh: 任何人煽動、協助、教唆、以金錢或者其他財物資助他人實施本法第二十條規定的犯罪的，即屬犯罪。情節嚴重的，處五年以上十年以下有期徒刑：情節較輕的，處五年以下有期徒刑，拘役或者管制。
items.textEn: Any person who incites, assists, instigates, or funds others with money or other property to commit crimes specified in Article 20 of this Law commits a crime. If the circumstances are serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years; if the circumstances are relatively minor, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention or public surveillance. Section 2. Crime of Subversion of State Power

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 22
items.textZh: 任何人組織、策劃、實施或者參與實施以下以武力、威脅使用武力或者其他非法手段旨在顛覆國家政權行為之一的，即屬犯罪： （一）推翻、破壞中華人民共和國憲法所確立的中華人民共和國根本制度； （二）推翻中華人民共和國中央政權機關或者香港特別行政區政權機關： （三）嚴重干擾、阻撓、破壞中華人民共和國中央政權機關或者香港特別行政區政權機關依法履行職能； （四）攻擊、破壞香港特別行政區政權機關履職場所及其設施，致使其無法正常履行職能。 犯前款罪，對首要分子或者罪行重大的，處無期徒刑或者十年以上有期徒刑；對積極參加的，處三年以上十年以下有期徒刑：對其他參加的，處三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制。
items.textEn: Anyone who organizes, plans, implements or participates in one of the following acts to subvert state power by force, threat of use of force or other illegal means commits a crime: (1) Overthrowing and destroying the fundamental system of the People's Republic of China established in the Constitution of the People's Republic of China; (2) Overthrowing the central power organs of the People's Republic of China or the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region power organs: (3) Seriously interfering with, obstructing, or undermining the performance of functions by the central power organs of the People's Republic of China or the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region power organs; (4) Attacking and damaging the places and facilities where the government organs of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region perform their duties, causing them to be unable to perform their functions normally. Whoever commits the crime in the preceding paragraph shall be sentenced to life imprisonment or fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years for the ringleaders or those whose crimes are serious; those who actively participate shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years; for other participants, they shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 23
items.textZh: 任何人煽動、協助、教唆，以金錢或者其他財物資助他人實施本法第二十二條規定的犯罪的，即屬犯罪。情節嚴重的，處五年以上十年以下有期徒刑；情節較輕的，處五年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制。
items.textEn: Any person who incites, assists, instigates, or uses money or other property to finance others to commit crimes specified in Article 22 of this Law shall be guilty of a crime. If the circumstances are serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years; if the circumstances are relatively minor, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention or public surveillance. Section 3 Crimes of Terrorist Activities

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 24
items.textZh: 為脅迫中央人民政府、香港特別行政區政府或者國際組織或者威嚇公眾以圖實現政治主張，組織、策劃、實施、參與實施或者威脅實施以下造成或者意圖造成嚴重社會危害的恐怖活動之一的，即屬犯罪： （一）針對人的嚴重暴力： （二）爆炸、縱火或者投放毒害性，放射性、傳染病病原體等物質； （三）破壞交通工具、交通設施、電力設備、燃氣設備或者其他易燃易爆設備； （四）嚴重干擾、破壞水、電、燃氣、交通、通訊、網絡等公共服務和管理的電子控制系統； （五）以其他危險方法嚴重危害公眾健康或者安全。 犯前款罪，致人重傷、死亡或者使公私財產遭受重大損失的，處無期徒刑或者十年以上有期徒刑；其他情形，處三年以上十年以下有期徒刑。
items.textEn: In order to coerce the Central People's Government, the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region or international organizations or to intimidate the public in order to realize political opinions, it is a crime to organize, plan, implement, participate in or threaten to implement one of the following terrorist activities that cause or intend to cause serious social harm: (1) Serious violence against people: (2) Explosion, arson, or the release of toxic, radioactive, infectious disease pathogens and other substances; (3) Damage to transportation, transportation facilities, electrical equipment, gas equipment or other flammable and explosive equipment; (4) Seriously interfere with or destroy electronic control systems for public services and management of water, electricity, gas, transportation, communications, networks, etc.; (5) Seriously endanger public health or safety by other dangerous methods. Whoever commits the crime in the preceding paragraph, causing serious injury or death to others or causing heavy losses to public or private property, shall be sentenced to life imprisonment or fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years; in other circumstances, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 25
items.textZh: 組織、領導恐怖活動組織的，即屬犯罪，處無期徒刑或者十年以上有期徒刑，並處沒收財產；積極參加的，處三年以上十年以下有期徒刑，並處罰金：其他參加的，處三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，可以並處罰金。 本法所指的恐怖活動組織，是指實施或者意圖實施本法第二十四條規定的恐怖活動罪行或者參與或者協助實施本法第二十四條規定的恐怖活動罪行的組織。
items.textEn: Whoever organizes and leads a terrorist organization shall commit a crime and shall be sentenced to life imprisonment or fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years, and shall also have property confiscated; whoever actively participates shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined; whoever participates in other activities shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or surveillance, and may also be fined. The terrorist organizations referred to in this Law refer to organizations that commit or intend to commit the crimes of terrorist activities stipulated in Article 24 of this Law or participate in or assist in the implementation of the crimes of terrorist activities stipulated in Article 24 of this Law.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 26
items.textZh: 為恐怖活動組織、恐怖活動人員、恐怖活動實施提供培訓、武器、信息、資金、物資、勞務、運輸、技術或者場所等支持、協助、便利，或者製造、非法管有爆炸性、毒害性、放射性、傳染病病原體等物質以及以其他形式準備實施恐怖活動的，即屬犯罪。情節嚴重的，處五年以上十年以下有期徒刑，並處罰金或者沒收財產；其他情形，處五年以下有期徒刑、 拘役或者管制，並處罰金。 有前款行為，同時構成其他犯罪的，依照處罰較重的規定定罪處罰。
items.textEn: It is a crime to provide training, weapons, information, funds, materials, labor services, transportation, technology or venues to support, assist or facilitate terrorist organizations, terrorist personnel or the implementation of terrorist activities, or to manufacture or illegally possess explosive, poisonous, radioactive, infectious disease pathogens and other substances, or to prepare to carry out terrorist activities in other ways, it is a crime. If the circumstances are serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined, or his property shall be confiscated; in other cases, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention, or surveillance, and shall also be fined. If the conduct in the preceding paragraph is committed and constitutes other crimes at the same time, he shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions on heavier penalties.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 27
items.textZh: 宣揚恐怖主義、煽動實施恐怖活動的，即屬犯罪。情節嚴重的，處五年以上十年以下有期徒刑，並處罰金或者沒收財產：其他情形，處五年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，並處罰金。
items.textEn: It is a crime to promote terrorism and incite the implementation of terrorist activities. If the circumstances are serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined, or his property shall be confiscated; in other cases, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention, or surveillance, and shall also be fined.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 28
items.textZh: 本節規定不影響依據香港特別行政區法律對其他形式的恐怖活動犯罪追究刑事責任並採取凍結財產等措施。
items.textEn: The provisions of this section do not affect the pursuit of criminal responsibility for other forms of terrorist activities and the adoption of measures such as freezing of property in accordance with the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Section 4. Crime of Colluding with Foreign Countries or Overseas Forces to Endanger National Security

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 29
items.textZh: 為外國或者境外機構、組織、人員竊取、刺探、收買、非法提供涉及國家安全的國家秘密或者情報的；請求外國或者境外機構、組織、人員實施，與外國或者境外機構、組織、人員串謀實施，或者直接或者間接接受外國或者境外機構、 組織、人員的指使、控制、資助或者其他形式的支援實施以下行為之一的，均屬犯罪： （一）對中華人民共和國發動戰爭，或者以武力或者武力相威脅，對中華人民共和國主權、統一和領土完整造成嚴重危害： （二）對香港特別行政區政府或者中央人民政府制定和執行法律、政策進行嚴重阻撓並可能造成嚴重後果； （三）對香港特別行政區選舉進行操控、破壞並可能造成嚴重後果： （四）對香港特別行政區或者中華人民共和國進行制裁、封鎖或者採取其他敵對行動； （五）通過各種非法方式引發香港特別行政區居民對中央人民政府或者香港特別行政區政府的憎恨並可能造成嚴重後果。 犯前款罪，處三年以上十年以下有期徒刑；罪行重大的，處無期徒刑或者十年以上有期徒刑。 本條第一款規定涉及的境外機構、組織、人員，按共同犯罪定罪處刑。
items.textEn: It is a crime to steal, spy on, buy, or illegally provide state secrets or intelligence related to national security for foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel; to request foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel to commit it, to conspire with foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel to commit it, or to directly or indirectly accept the instruction, control, funding, or other forms of support from foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel to commit any of the following acts, shall be a crime: (1) Waging war against the People's Republic of China, or using force or the threat of force, causing serious harm to the sovereignty, unity and territorial integrity of the People's Republic of China: (2) Seriously obstructing the formulation and implementation of laws and policies by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government or the Central People's Government, which may cause serious consequences; (3) Manipulating and undermining the elections of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, which may cause serious consequences: (4) Sanctioning, blocking or taking other hostile actions against the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region or the People's Republic of China; (5) Using various illegal methods to cause hatred among residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region against the Central People's Government or the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and may cause serious consequences. Anyone who commits the crime in the preceding paragraph shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years; if the crime is serious, he shall be sentenced to life imprisonment or fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years. The overseas institutions, organizations, and personnel involved in the first paragraph of this article shall be convicted and sentenced for joint crimes.

items.textZh: 為實施本法第二十條、第二十二條規定的犯罪， 與外國或者境外機構、組織、人員串謀，或者直接或者間接接受外國或者境外機構、組織、人員的指使、控制、資助或者其他形式的支援的，依照本法第二十條、第二十二條的規定從重處罰。
items.textEn: Anyone who conspires with foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel in order to commit crimes stipulated in Articles 20 and 22 of this Law, or who directly or indirectly accepts the instruction, control, funding, or other forms of support from foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel, shall be severely punished in accordance with the provisions of Articles 20 and 22 of this Law. blocks.question: 《香港國安法》第 20 條原文：「（二）非法改變香港特別行政區或者中華人民共和國其他任何部分的__________；」

blocks.question: 《香港國安法》第 24 條原文：「（四）嚴重干擾、破壞水、電、燃氣、交通、通訊、網絡等公共服務和__________的電子控制系統；」

feedbackCorrect.text: 答案係 A。《香港國安法》第 24 條訂明：「為脅迫中央人民政府、香港特別行政區政府或者國際組織或者威嚇公眾以圖實現政治主張，組織、策劃、實施、參與實施或者威脅實施以下造成或者意圖造成嚴重社會危害的恐怖活動之一的，即屬犯罪： （一）針對人的嚴重暴力： （二）爆炸、縱火或者投放毒害性，放射性、傳染病病原體等物質； （三）破壞交通工具、交通設施、電力設備、燃氣設備或者其他易燃易爆設備； （四）嚴重干擾、破壞水、電、燃氣、交通、通訊、網絡等公共服務和管理的電子控制系統； （五）以其他危險方法嚴重危害公眾健康或者安全。 犯前款罪，致人重傷、死亡或者使公私財產遭受重大損失的，處無期徒刑或者十年以上有期徒刑；其他情形，處三年以上十年以下有期徒刑。」

blocks.question: 《香港國安法》第 29 條原文：「為外國或者境外機構、組織、人員竊取、刺探、收買、非法提供涉及國家安全的國家__________或者情報的；」

feedbackCorrect.text: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 29 條訂明：「為外國或者境外機構、組織、人員竊取、刺探、收買、非法提供涉及國家安全的國家秘密或者情報的；請求外國或者境外機構、組織、人員實施，與外國或者境外機構、組織、人員串謀實施，或者直接或者間接接受外國或者境外機構、 組織、人員的指使、控制、資助或者其他形式的支援實施以下行為之一的，均屬犯罪： （一）對中華人民共和國發動戰爭，或者以武力或者武力相威脅，對中華人民共和國主權、統一和領土完整造成嚴重危害： （二）對香港特別行政區政府或者中央人民政府制定和執行法律、政策進行嚴重阻撓並可能造成嚴重後果； （三）對香港特別行政區選舉進行操控、破壞並可能造成嚴重後果： （四）對香港特別行政區或者中華人民共和國進行制裁、封鎖或者採取其他敵對行動； （五）通過各種非法方式引發香港特別行政區居民對中央人民政府或者香港特別行政區政府的憎恨並可能造成嚴重後果。 犯前款罪，處三年以上十年以下有期徒刑；罪行重大的，處無期徒刑或者十年以上有期徒刑。 本條第一款規定涉及的境外機構、組織、人員，按共同犯罪定罪處刑。」

blocks.text: 今課總結
你已按次序完成 11 個重點嘅理解同測試。以下係今課重點：

items: 第 20 條：分裂國家行為不論有否使用武力均屬犯罪
第 21 條：煽動、協助或資助他人分裂國家即屬犯罪
第 22 條：以武力或非法手段顛覆國家政權即屬犯罪
第 23 條：煽動、協助或資助他人顛覆國家政權即屬犯罪
第 24 條：為政治主張實施恐怖活動即屬犯罪
第 25 條：組織或領導恐怖活動組織屬犯罪，最高可判無期徒刑
第 26 條：支援、協助或準備恐怖活動即屬犯罪
第 27 條：宣揚恐怖主義、煽動實施恐怖活動的，即屬犯罪
第 28 條：其他恐怖活動仍可按香港法律追究及凍結財產
第 29 條：勾結外國或境外勢力危害國安即屬犯罪
第 30 條：獲境外支援實施分裂或顛覆罪會從重處罰

blocks.text: 刑罰、效力與案件程序
今課會讀《香港國安法》第 31–47 條，掌握法人刑責、從輕處罰情況、法律效力範圍、案件管轄，同犯罪得益及參選資格等後果。
你亦會認識國安案件嘅立案偵查、檢控、保釋、指定法官、陪審團同證明書等特別程序，以及相關決定由邊個機關作出。
今課重點

items: 第 31 條：公司、團體等法人或者非法人組織實施本法規定的犯罪的，對該組織判處罰金
第 32 條：犯罪所得及犯罪工具須予追繳或沒收
第 33 條：自首、放棄犯罪或協助破案可獲從寬處罰
第 34 條：非永久居民犯國安罪可被驅逐出境
第 35 條：被判國安罪即喪失參選及出任公職資格
第 36 條：任何人在香港特區內實施本法規定的犯罪的，適用本法
第 37 條：香港永久居民等境外犯罪亦適用國安法
第 38 條：非永久居民境外針對香港犯罪亦適用國安法
第 39 條：本法施行以後的行為，適用本法定罪處刑
第 40 條：香港特區對本法規定的犯罪案件行使管轄權，但本法第五十五條規定的情形除外
第 41 條：香港管轄國安案件並適用本地訴訟程序
第 42 條：國安案件須從速辦理並適用特別保釋門檻
第 43 條：警務處國安部門調查危害國安案件時，可搜查相關地方及凍結犯罪相關財產
第 44 條：行政長官指定處理國安案件嘅法官
第 45 條：國安案件原則上按香港其他法律處理
第 46 條：律政司長可依法指示國安案件無陪審團審理
第 47 條：國安或國家秘密認定須取得行政長官證明書

blocks.text: 學習《香港國安法》第 31–47 條
請仔細閱讀以下官方條文，留意加粗嘅關鍵規則；稍後會有測驗，檢查你對每條法例嘅理解。

blocks.title: 官方條文｜《香港國安法》第 31–47 條

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 31
items.textZh: 公司、團體等法人或者非法人組織實施本法規定的犯罪的，對該組織判處罰金。 公司、團體等法人或者非法人組織因犯本法規定的罪行受到刑事處罰的，應責令其暫停運作或者吊銷其執照或者營業許可證。
items.textEn: If a company, group or other legal person or unincorporated organization commits a crime stipulated in this law, the organization shall be fined. If a company, group or other legal person or unincorporated organization is subject to criminal punishment for committing a crime stipulated in this law, it shall be ordered to suspend its operations or its license or business permit shall be revoked.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 32
items.textZh: 因實施本法規定的犯罪而獲得的資助、收益、 報酬等違法所得以及用於或者意圖用於犯罪的資金和工具，應當予以追繳、沒收。
items.textEn: Funding, income, remuneration and other illegal gains obtained from committing crimes stipulated in this law, as well as funds and tools used or intended to be used in crimes, shall be recovered and confiscated.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 33
items.textZh: 有以下情形的，對有關犯罪行為人、犯罪嫌疑人、被告人可以從輕、減輕處罰；犯罪較輕的，可以免除處罰： （一）在犯罪過程中，自動放棄犯罪或者自動有效地防止犯罪結果發生的； （二）自動投案，如實供述自己的罪行的； •（三）揭發他人犯罪行為，查證屬實，或者提供重要線索得以偵破其他案件的。 被採取強制措施的犯罪嫌疑人、被告人如實供述執法、司法機關未掌握的本人犯有本法規定的其他罪行的，按前款第二項規定處理。
items.textEn: Under the following circumstances, relevant criminal perpetrators, criminal suspects and defendants may be given lighter or reduced punishments; if the crime is minor, they may be exempted from punishment: (1) During the crime process, voluntarily give up the crime or automatically and effectively prevent the consequences of the crime; (2) Voluntarily surrender and truthfully confess their crime; • (3) Expose other people's criminal behavior and verify it to be true, or provide important clues to solve other cases. If a criminal suspect or defendant against whom compulsory measures are taken truthfully confesses that he or she has committed other crimes stipulated in this law and is not aware of the law enforcement and judicial authorities, he or she shall be dealt with in accordance with the provisions of Item 2 of the preceding paragraph.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 34
items.textZh: 不具有香港特別行政區永久性居民身份的人實施本法規定的犯罪的，可以獨立適用或者附加適用驅逐出境。 不具有香港特別行政區永久性居民身份的人違反本法規定， 因任何原因不對其追究刑事責任的，也可以驅逐出境。
items.textEn: If a person who does not have the status of a permanent resident of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region commits a crime stipulated in this Law, he may be deported independently or additionally. Persons who do not have permanent resident status in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may also be deported if they violate the provisions of this Law and are not held criminally responsible for any reason.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 35
items.textZh: 任何人經法院判決犯危害國家安全罪行的，即喪失作為候選人參加香港特別行政區舉行的立法會、區議會選舉或者出任香港特別行政區任何公職或者行政長官選舉委員會委員的資格；曾經宣誓或者聲明擁護中華人民共和國香港特別行政區基本法，效忠中華人民共和國香港特別行政區的立法會議員、政府官員及公務人員、行政會議成員，法官及其他司法人員、區議員，即時喪失該等職務，並喪失參選或者出任上述職務的資格。 前款規定資格或者職務的喪失，由負責組織、管理有關選舉或者公職任免的機構宣佈。
items.textEn: Anyone who is convicted by a court of committing a crime endangering national security will lose the qualification to participate as a candidate in the Legislative Council or District Council elections held in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region or to hold any public office or member of the Chief Executive Election Committee of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; Legislative Council members, government officials and civil servants, members of the Executive Council, judges and other judicial personnel, and district councils who have sworn or declared to support the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China and to be loyal to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China. members shall immediately lose such positions and shall be disqualified from running for election or holding the above-mentioned positions. The loss of qualifications or positions stipulated in the preceding paragraph shall be announced by the agency responsible for organizing and managing relevant elections or appointment and removal of public offices. Section 6 Scope of Effect

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 36
items.textZh: 任何人在香港特別行政區內實施本法規定的犯罪的，適用本法。犯罪的行為或者結果有一項發生在香港特別行政區內的，就認為是在香港特別行政區內犯罪。 在香港特別行政區註冊的船舶或者航空器內實施本法規定的犯罪的，也適用本法。
items.textEn: This Law shall apply to any person who commits a crime specified in this Law within the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. If any of the criminal acts or results occur within the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, it is deemed to be a crime committed within the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. This Law shall also apply to crimes stipulated in this Law committed on board a ship or aircraft registered in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 37
items.textZh: 香港特別行政區永久性居民或者在香港特別行政區成立的公司，團體等法人或者非法人組織在香港特別行政區以外實施本法規定的犯罪的，適用本法。
items.textEn: If a permanent resident of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region or a company, group or other legal person or unincorporated organization established in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region commits crimes stipulated in this Law outside the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, this Law shall apply.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 38
items.textZh: 不具有香港特別行政區永久性居民身份的人在香港特別行政區以外針對香港特別行政區實施本法規定的犯罪的，適用本法。
items.textEn: If a person who does not have the status of a permanent resident of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region commits a crime stipulated in this Law against the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region outside the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, this Law shall apply.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 39
items.textZh: 本法施行以後的行為，適用本法定罪處刑。
items.textEn: Behaviors committed after the implementation of this law shall be convicted and sentenced according to this law. Chapter 4 Case Jurisdiction, Law Application and Procedure

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 40
items.textZh: 香港特別行政區對本法規定的犯罪案件行使管轄權，但本法第五十五條規定的情形除外。
items.textEn: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall exercise jurisdiction over criminal cases stipulated in this Law, except for the circumstances provided for in Article 55 of this Law.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 41
items.textZh: 香港特別行政區管轄危害國家安全犯罪案件的立案偵查、檢控、審判和刑罰的執行等訴訟程序事宜，適用本法和香港特別行政區本地法律。 未經律政司長書面同意，任何人不得就危害國家安全犯罪案件提出檢控。但該規定不影響就有關犯罪依法逮捕犯罪嫌疑人並將其羈押，也不影響該等犯罪嫌疑人申請保釋。 香港特別行政區管轄的危害國家安全犯罪案件的審判循公訴程序進行。 審判應當公開進行。因為涉及國家秘密、公共秩序等情形不宜公開審理的，禁止新聞界和公眾旁聽全部或者一部分審理程序，但判決結果應當一律公開宣佈。
items.textEn: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region has jurisdiction over the filing, investigation, prosecution, trial, execution of penalties and other procedural matters in cases of crimes endangering national security. This Law and the local laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall apply. No person may initiate prosecution for crimes endangering national security without the written consent of the Secretary for Justice. However, this provision does not affect the arrest and detention of criminal suspects in accordance with the law for relevant crimes, nor does it affect the application for bail by such criminal suspects. Trials of crimes endangering national security under the jurisdiction of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region are conducted according to public prosecution procedures. Trials should be held in public. If a public trial is not suitable due to circumstances involving state secrets, public order, etc., the press and the public are prohibited from observing all or part of the trial proceedings, but the judgment results must be announced publicly.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 42
items.textZh: 香港特別行政區執法、司法機關在適用香港特別行政區現行法律有關羈押、審理期限等方面的規定時，應當確保危害國家安全犯罪案件公正、及時辦理，有效防範、制止和懲治危害國家安全犯罪。 對犯罪嫌疑人、被告人，除非法官有充足理由相信其不會繼續實施危害國家安全行為的，不得准予保釋。
items.textEn: When applying the current laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region regarding detention and trial periods, the law enforcement and judicial authorities of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall ensure that cases of crimes endangering national security are handled fairly and promptly, and effectively prevent, stop and punish crimes endangering national security. Criminal suspects and defendants shall not be granted bail unless the judge has sufficient reasons to believe that they will not continue to commit acts endangering national security.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 43
items.textZh: 香港特別行政區政府警務處維護國家安全部門辦理危害國家安全犯罪案件時，可以採取香港特別行政區現行法律准予警方等執法部門在調查嚴重犯罪案件時採取的各種措施， 並可以採取以下措施： （一）搜查可能存有犯罪證據的處所、車輛、船隻、航空器以及其他有關地方和電子設備； （二）要求涉嫌實施危害國家安全犯罪行為的人員交出旅行證件或者限制其離境； （三）對用於或者意圖用於犯罪的財產、因犯罪所得的收益等與犯罪相關的財產，予以凍結，申請限制令、押記令，沒收令以及充公； （四）要求信息發佈人或者有關服務商移除信息或者提供協助： （五）要求外國及境外政治性組織，外國及境外當局或者政治性組織的代理人提供資料； （六）經行政長官批准，對有合理理由懷疑涉及實施危害國家安全犯罪的人員進行截取通訊和秘密監察； （七）對有合理理由懷疑擁有與偵查有關的資料或者管有有關物料的人員，要求其回答問題和提交資料或者物料。 香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會對警務處維護國家安全部門等執法機構採取本條第一款規定措施負有監督責任。 授權香港特別行政區行政長官會同香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會為採取本條第一款規定措施制定相關實施細則。
items.textEn: When handling cases of crimes endangering national security, the Police Force of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government may adopt various measures that the current laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region allow the police and other law enforcement agencies to take when investigating serious criminal cases, and may take the following measures: (1) Search premises, vehicles, ships, aircraft and other relevant places and electronic equipment that may contain criminal evidence; (2) Require persons suspected of committing crimes endangering national security to surrender their travel documents or restrict their departure; (3) Freeze property used or intended to be used for crime, proceeds from crime and other crime-related property, and apply for restraint orders, charging orders, confiscation orders and confiscation; (4) Request information publishers or relevant service providers to remove information or provide assistance: (5) Request foreign and overseas political organizations, foreign and overseas authorities or agents of political organizations to provide information; (6) With the approval of the Chief Executive, if there are reasonable grounds to suspect that the person is involved in committing crimes that endanger the country Interception of communications and secret surveillance by personnel who commit national security crimes; (7) Require persons who have reasonable grounds to suspect that they possess information related to the investigation or are in possession of relevant materials to answer questions and submit information or materials. The Committee for Safeguarding National Security of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall be responsible for supervising the adoption of the measures specified in paragraph 1 of this article by law enforcement agencies such as the National Security Department of the Police Force. Authorizes the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to formulate relevant implementation rules for the implementation of the measures specified in paragraph 1 of this article in conjunction with the Committee for the Maintenance of National Security of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 44
items.textZh: 香港特別行政區行政長官應當從裁判官、區域法院法官、高等法院原訟法庭法官、上訴法庭法官以及終審法院法官中指定若干名法官，也可從暫委或者特委法官中指定若干名法官，負責處理危害國家安全犯罪案件。行政長官在指定法官前可徵詢香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會和終審法院首席法官的意見。上述指定法官任期一年。 凡有危害國家安全言行的，不得被指定為審理危害國家安全犯罪案件的法官。在獲任指定法官期間，如有危害國家安全言行的，終止其指定法官資格。 在裁判法院、區域法院、高等法院和終審法院就危害國家安全犯罪案件提起的刑事檢控程序應當分別由各該法院的指定法官處理。
items.textEn: The Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall designate a number of judges from among the magistrates, District Court judges, judges of the Court of First Instance of the High Court, judges of the Court of Appeal and judges of the Court of Final Appeal, and may also designate a number of judges from the Temporary Commission or the Special Commission to handle cases of crimes endangering national security. The Chief Executive may seek the opinions of the Committee for Safeguarding National Security of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the Chief Judge of the Supreme Court before appointing a judge. The above-mentioned designated judges shall serve for one year. Anyone who has words or deeds that endanger national security shall not be appointed as a judge to hear cases involving crimes that endanger national security. During the period of appointment as a designated judge, if any words or deeds that endanger national security are found, his or her qualification as a designated judge will be terminated. Criminal prosecution proceedings involving cases of crimes endangering national security in the Magistrates' Courts, District Courts, High Court and Court of Final Appeal shall be handled by designated judges of each court respectively.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 45
items.textZh: 除本法另有規定外，裁判法院、區域法院、高等法院和終審法院應當按照香港特別行政區的其他法律處理就危害國家安全犯罪案件提起的刑事檢控程序。
items.textEn: Except as otherwise provided in this Law, the magistrates' courts, regional courts, high courts and courts of final appeal shall handle criminal prosecution procedures in cases of crimes endangering national security in accordance with other laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 46
items.textZh: 對高等法院原訟法庭進行的就危害國家安全犯罪案件提起的刑事檢控程序，律政司長可基於保護國家秘密、案件具有涉外因素或者保障陪審員及其家人的人身安全等理由，發出證書指示相關訴訟毋須在有陪審團的情況下進行審理。凡律政司長發出上述證書，高等法院原訟法庭應當在沒有陪審團的情況下進行審理，並由三名法官組成審判庭。 凡律政司長發出前款規定的證書，適用於相關訴訟的香港特別行政區任何法律條文關於“陪審團”或者“陪審團的裁決”， 均應當理解為指法官或者法官作為事實裁斷者的職能。
items.textEn: For criminal prosecution proceedings in the Court of First Instance of the High Court regarding crimes endangering national security, the Secretary for Justice may issue a certificate directing that the relevant proceedings do not need to be heard with a jury on the grounds of protecting state secrets, having foreign elements in the case, or protecting the personal safety of jurors and their families. Where the Secretary for Justice issues such a certificate, the Court of First Instance of the High Court shall conduct a trial without a jury and by a bench of three judges. Whenever the Secretary for Justice issues the certificate specified in the preceding paragraph, any legal provisions of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region applicable to the relevant litigation regarding "jury" or "jury's verdict" shall be understood to refer to the judge or the judge's function as a fact-finder.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 47
items.textZh: 香港特別行政區法院在審理案件中遇有涉及有關行為是否涉及國家安全或者有關證據材料是否涉及國家秘密的認定問題，應取得行政長官就該等問題發出的證明書，上述證明書對法院有約束力。
items.textEn: When the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region encounter cases involving the determination of whether relevant conduct involves national security or whether relevant evidence materials involve state secrets, they should obtain certificates issued by the Chief Executive on these issues. The above certificates are binding on the court. Chapter 5 Central People’s Government’s National Security Agencies in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

blocks.text: 今課總結
你已按次序完成 17 個重點嘅理解同測試。以下係今課重點：

items: 第 31 條：公司、團體等法人或者非法人組織實施本法規定的犯罪的，對該組織判處罰金
第 32 條：犯罪所得及犯罪工具須予追繳或沒收
第 33 條：自首、放棄犯罪或協助破案可獲從寬處罰
第 34 條：非永久居民犯國安罪可被驅逐出境
第 35 條：被判國安罪即喪失參選及出任公職資格
第 36 條：任何人在香港特區內實施本法規定的犯罪的，適用本法
第 37 條：香港永久居民等境外犯罪亦適用國安法
第 38 條：非永久居民境外針對香港犯罪亦適用國安法
第 39 條：本法施行以後的行為，適用本法定罪處刑
第 40 條：香港特區對本法規定的犯罪案件行使管轄權，但本法第五十五條規定的情形除外
第 41 條：香港管轄國安案件並適用本地訴訟程序
第 42 條：國安案件須從速辦理並適用特別保釋門檻
第 43 條：警務處國安部門調查危害國安案件時，可搜查相關地方及凍結犯罪相關財產
第 44 條：行政長官指定處理國安案件嘅法官
第 45 條：國安案件原則上按香港其他法律處理
第 46 條：律政司長可依法指示國安案件無陪審團審理
第 47 條：國安或國家秘密認定須取得行政長官證明書

第 35 條：被判國安罪即喪失參選及出任公職資格
第 36 條：任何人在香港特區內實施本法規定的犯罪的，適用本法
第 37 條：香港永久居民等境外犯罪亦適用國安法
第 38 條：非永久居民境外針對香港犯罪亦適用國安法
第 39 條：本法施行以後的行為，適用本法定罪處刑
第 40 條：香港特區對本法規定的犯罪案件行使管轄權，但本法第五十五條規定的情形除外
第 41 條：香港管轄國安案件並適用本地訴訟程序
第 42 條：國安案件須從速辦理並適用特別保釋門檻
第 43 條：警務處國安部門調查危害國安案件時，可搜查相關地方及凍結犯罪相關財產
第 44 條：行政長官指定處理國安案件嘅法官
第 45 條：國安案件原則上按香港其他法律處理
第 46 條：律政司長可依法指示國安案件無陪審團審理
第 47 條：國安或國家秘密認定須取得行政長官證明書

blocks.text: 學習《香港國安法》第 31–47 條
請仔細閱讀以下官方條文，留意加粗嘅關鍵規則；稍後會有測驗，檢查你對每條法例嘅理解。

blocks.title: 官方條文｜《香港國安法》第 31–47 條

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 31
items.textZh: 公司、團體等法人或者非法人組織實施本法規定的犯罪的，對該組織判處罰金。 公司、團體等法人或者非法人組織因犯本法規定的罪行受到刑事處罰的，應責令其暫停運作或者吊銷其執照或者營業許可證。
items.textEn: If a company, group or other legal person or unincorporated organization commits a crime stipulated in this law, the organization shall be fined. If a company, group or other legal person or unincorporated organization is subject to criminal punishment for committing a crime stipulated in this law, it shall be ordered to suspend its operations or its license or business permit shall be revoked.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 32
items.textZh: 因實施本法規定的犯罪而獲得的資助、收益、 報酬等違法所得以及用於或者意圖用於犯罪的資金和工具，應當予以追繳、沒收。
items.textEn: Funding, income, remuneration and other illegal gains obtained from committing crimes stipulated in this law, as well as funds and tools used or intended to be used in crimes, shall be recovered and confiscated.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 33
items.textZh: 有以下情形的，對有關犯罪行為人、犯罪嫌疑人、被告人可以從輕、減輕處罰；犯罪較輕的，可以免除處罰： （一）在犯罪過程中，自動放棄犯罪或者自動有效地防止犯罪結果發生的； （二）自動投案，如實供述自己的罪行的； •（三）揭發他人犯罪行為，查證屬實，或者提供重要線索得以偵破其他案件的。 被採取強制措施的犯罪嫌疑人、被告人如實供述執法、司法機關未掌握的本人犯有本法規定的其他罪行的，按前款第二項規定處理。
items.textEn: Under the following circumstances, relevant criminal perpetrators, criminal suspects and defendants may be given lighter or reduced punishments; if the crime is minor, they may be exempted from punishment: (1) During the crime process, voluntarily give up the crime or automatically and effectively prevent the consequences of the crime; (2) Voluntarily surrender and truthfully confess their crime; • (3) Expose other people's criminal behavior and verify it to be true, or provide important clues to solve other cases. If a criminal suspect or defendant against whom compulsory measures are taken truthfully confesses that he or she has committed other crimes stipulated in this law and is not aware of the law enforcement and judicial authorities, he or she shall be dealt with in accordance with the provisions of Item 2 of the preceding paragraph.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 34
items.textZh: 不具有香港特別行政區永久性居民身份的人實施本法規定的犯罪的，可以獨立適用或者附加適用驅逐出境。 不具有香港特別行政區永久性居民身份的人違反本法規定， 因任何原因不對其追究刑事責任的，也可以驅逐出境。
items.textEn: If a person who does not have the status of a permanent resident of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region commits a crime stipulated in this Law, he may be deported independently or additionally. Persons who do not have permanent resident status in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may also be deported if they violate the provisions of this Law and are not held criminally responsible for any reason.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 35
items.textZh: 任何人經法院判決犯危害國家安全罪行的，即喪失作為候選人參加香港特別行政區舉行的立法會、區議會選舉或者出任香港特別行政區任何公職或者行政長官選舉委員會委員的資格；曾經宣誓或者聲明擁護中華人民共和國香港特別行政區基本法，效忠中華人民共和國香港特別行政區的立法會議員、政府官員及公務人員、行政會議成員，法官及其他司法人員、區議員，即時喪失該等職務，並喪失參選或者出任上述職務的資格。 前款規定資格或者職務的喪失，由負責組織、管理有關選舉或者公職任免的機構宣佈。
items.textEn: Anyone who is convicted by a court of committing a crime endangering national security will lose the qualification to participate as a candidate in the Legislative Council or District Council elections held in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region or to hold any public office or member of the Chief Executive Election Committee of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; Legislative Council members, government officials and civil servants, members of the Executive Council, judges and other judicial personnel, and district councils who have sworn or declared to support the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China and to be loyal to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China. members shall immediately lose such positions and shall be disqualified from running for election or holding the above-mentioned positions. The loss of qualifications or positions stipulated in the preceding paragraph shall be announced by the agency responsible for organizing and managing relevant elections or appointment and removal of public offices. Section 6 Scope of Effect

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 36
items.textZh: 任何人在香港特別行政區內實施本法規定的犯罪的，適用本法。犯罪的行為或者結果有一項發生在香港特別行政區內的，就認為是在香港特別行政區內犯罪。 在香港特別行政區註冊的船舶或者航空器內實施本法規定的犯罪的，也適用本法。
items.textEn: This Law shall apply to any person who commits a crime specified in this Law within the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. If any of the criminal acts or results occur within the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, it is deemed to be a crime committed within the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. This Law shall also apply to crimes stipulated in this Law committed on board a ship or aircraft registered in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 37
items.textZh: 香港特別行政區永久性居民或者在香港特別行政區成立的公司，團體等法人或者非法人組織在香港特別行政區以外實施本法規定的犯罪的，適用本法。
items.textEn: If a permanent resident of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region or a company, group or other legal person or unincorporated organization established in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region commits crimes stipulated in this Law outside the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, this Law shall apply.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 38
items.textZh: 不具有香港特別行政區永久性居民身份的人在香港特別行政區以外針對香港特別行政區實施本法規定的犯罪的，適用本法。
items.textEn: If a person who does not have the status of a permanent resident of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region commits a crime stipulated in this Law against the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region outside the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, this Law shall apply.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 39
items.textZh: 本法施行以後的行為，適用本法定罪處刑。
items.textEn: Behaviors committed after the implementation of this law shall be convicted and sentenced according to this law. Chapter 4 Case Jurisdiction, Law Application and Procedure

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 40
items.textZh: 香港特別行政區對本法規定的犯罪案件行使管轄權，但本法第五十五條規定的情形除外。
items.textEn: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall exercise jurisdiction over criminal cases stipulated in this Law, except for the circumstances provided for in Article 55 of this Law.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 41
items.textZh: 香港特別行政區管轄危害國家安全犯罪案件的立案偵查、檢控、審判和刑罰的執行等訴訟程序事宜，適用本法和香港特別行政區本地法律。 未經律政司長書面同意，任何人不得就危害國家安全犯罪案件提出檢控。但該規定不影響就有關犯罪依法逮捕犯罪嫌疑人並將其羈押，也不影響該等犯罪嫌疑人申請保釋。 香港特別行政區管轄的危害國家安全犯罪案件的審判循公訴程序進行。 審判應當公開進行。因為涉及國家秘密、公共秩序等情形不宜公開審理的，禁止新聞界和公眾旁聽全部或者一部分審理程序，但判決結果應當一律公開宣佈。
items.textEn: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region has jurisdiction over the filing, investigation, prosecution, trial, execution of penalties and other procedural matters in cases of crimes endangering national security. This Law and the local laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall apply. No person may initiate prosecution for crimes endangering national security without the written consent of the Secretary for Justice. However, this provision does not affect the arrest and detention of criminal suspects in accordance with the law for relevant crimes, nor does it affect the application for bail by such criminal suspects. Trials of crimes endangering national security under the jurisdiction of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region are conducted according to public prosecution procedures. Trials should be held in public. If a public trial is not suitable due to circumstances involving state secrets, public order, etc., the press and the public are prohibited from observing all or part of the trial proceedings, but the judgment results must be announced publicly.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 42
items.textZh: 香港特別行政區執法、司法機關在適用香港特別行政區現行法律有關羈押、審理期限等方面的規定時，應當確保危害國家安全犯罪案件公正、及時辦理，有效防範、制止和懲治危害國家安全犯罪。 對犯罪嫌疑人、被告人，除非法官有充足理由相信其不會繼續實施危害國家安全行為的，不得准予保釋。
items.textEn: When applying the current laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region regarding detention and trial periods, the law enforcement and judicial authorities of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall ensure that cases of crimes endangering national security are handled fairly and promptly, and effectively prevent, stop and punish crimes endangering national security. Criminal suspects and defendants shall not be granted bail unless the judge has sufficient reasons to believe that they will not continue to commit acts endangering national security.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 43
items.textZh: 香港特別行政區政府警務處維護國家安全部門辦理危害國家安全犯罪案件時，可以採取香港特別行政區現行法律准予警方等執法部門在調查嚴重犯罪案件時採取的各種措施， 並可以採取以下措施： （一）搜查可能存有犯罪證據的處所、車輛、船隻、航空器以及其他有關地方和電子設備； （二）要求涉嫌實施危害國家安全犯罪行為的人員交出旅行證件或者限制其離境； （三）對用於或者意圖用於犯罪的財產、因犯罪所得的收益等與犯罪相關的財產，予以凍結，申請限制令、押記令，沒收令以及充公； （四）要求信息發佈人或者有關服務商移除信息或者提供協助： （五）要求外國及境外政治性組織，外國及境外當局或者政治性組織的代理人提供資料； （六）經行政長官批准，對有合理理由懷疑涉及實施危害國家安全犯罪的人員進行截取通訊和秘密監察； （七）對有合理理由懷疑擁有與偵查有關的資料或者管有有關物料的人員，要求其回答問題和提交資料或者物料。 香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會對警務處維護國家安全部門等執法機構採取本條第一款規定措施負有監督責任。 授權香港特別行政區行政長官會同香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會為採取本條第一款規定措施制定相關實施細則。
items.textEn: When handling cases of crimes endangering national security, the Police Force of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government may adopt various measures that the current laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region allow the police and other law enforcement agencies to take when investigating serious criminal cases, and may take the following measures: (1) Search premises, vehicles, ships, aircraft and other relevant places and electronic equipment that may contain criminal evidence; (2) Require persons suspected of committing crimes endangering national security to surrender their travel documents or restrict their departure; (3) Freeze property used or intended to be used for crime, proceeds from crime and other crime-related property, and apply for restraint orders, charging orders, confiscation orders and confiscation; (4) Request information publishers or relevant service providers to remove information or provide assistance: (5) Request foreign and overseas political organizations, foreign and overseas authorities or agents of political organizations to provide information; (6) With the approval of the Chief Executive, if there are reasonable grounds to suspect that the person is involved in committing crimes that endanger the country Interception of communications and secret surveillance by personnel who commit national security crimes; (7) Require persons who have reasonable grounds to suspect that they possess information related to the investigation or are in possession of relevant materials to answer questions and submit information or materials. The Committee for Safeguarding National Security of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall be responsible for supervising the adoption of the measures specified in paragraph 1 of this article by law enforcement agencies such as the National Security Department of the Police Force. Authorizes the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to formulate relevant implementation rules for the implementation of the measures specified in paragraph 1 of this article in conjunction with the Committee for the Maintenance of National Security of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 44
items.textZh: 香港特別行政區行政長官應當從裁判官、區域法院法官、高等法院原訟法庭法官、上訴法庭法官以及終審法院法官中指定若干名法官，也可從暫委或者特委法官中指定若干名法官，負責處理危害國家安全犯罪案件。行政長官在指定法官前可徵詢香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會和終審法院首席法官的意見。上述指定法官任期一年。 凡有危害國家安全言行的，不得被指定為審理危害國家安全犯罪案件的法官。在獲任指定法官期間，如有危害國家安全言行的，終止其指定法官資格。 在裁判法院、區域法院、高等法院和終審法院就危害國家安全犯罪案件提起的刑事檢控程序應當分別由各該法院的指定法官處理。
items.textEn: The Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall designate a number of judges from among the magistrates, District Court judges, judges of the Court of First Instance of the High Court, judges of the Court of Appeal and judges of the Court of Final Appeal, and may also designate a number of judges from the Temporary Commission or the Special Commission to handle cases of crimes endangering national security. The Chief Executive may seek the opinions of the Committee for Safeguarding National Security of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the Chief Judge of the Supreme Court before appointing a judge. The above-mentioned designated judges shall serve for one year. Anyone who has words or deeds that endanger national security shall not be appointed as a judge to hear cases involving crimes that endanger national security. During the period of appointment as a designated judge, if any words or deeds that endanger national security are found, his or her qualification as a designated judge will be terminated. Criminal prosecution proceedings involving cases of crimes endangering national security in the Magistrates' Courts, District Courts, High Court and Court of Final Appeal shall be handled by designated judges of each court respectively.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 45
items.textZh: 除本法另有規定外，裁判法院、區域法院、高等法院和終審法院應當按照香港特別行政區的其他法律處理就危害國家安全犯罪案件提起的刑事檢控程序。
items.textEn: Except as otherwise provided in this Law, the magistrates' courts, regional courts, high courts and courts of final appeal shall handle criminal prosecution procedures in cases of crimes endangering national security in accordance with other laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 46
items.textZh: 對高等法院原訟法庭進行的就危害國家安全犯罪案件提起的刑事檢控程序，律政司長可基於保護國家秘密、案件具有涉外因素或者保障陪審員及其家人的人身安全等理由，發出證書指示相關訴訟毋須在有陪審團的情況下進行審理。凡律政司長發出上述證書，高等法院原訟法庭應當在沒有陪審團的情況下進行審理，並由三名法官組成審判庭。 凡律政司長發出前款規定的證書，適用於相關訴訟的香港特別行政區任何法律條文關於“陪審團”或者“陪審團的裁決”， 均應當理解為指法官或者法官作為事實裁斷者的職能。
items.textEn: For criminal prosecution proceedings in the Court of First Instance of the High Court regarding crimes endangering national security, the Secretary for Justice may issue a certificate directing that the relevant proceedings do not need to be heard with a jury on the grounds of protecting state secrets, having foreign elements in the case, or protecting the personal safety of jurors and their families. Where the Secretary for Justice issues such a certificate, the Court of First Instance of the High Court shall conduct a trial without a jury and by a bench of three judges. Whenever the Secretary for Justice issues the certificate specified in the preceding paragraph, any legal provisions of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region applicable to the relevant litigation regarding "jury" or "jury's verdict" shall be understood to refer to the judge or the judge's function as a fact-finder.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 47
items.textZh: 香港特別行政區法院在審理案件中遇有涉及有關行為是否涉及國家安全或者有關證據材料是否涉及國家秘密的認定問題，應取得行政長官就該等問題發出的證明書，上述證明書對法院有約束力。
items.textEn: When the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region encounter cases involving the determination of whether relevant conduct involves national security or whether relevant evidence materials involve state secrets, they should obtain certificates issued by the Chief Executive on these issues. The above certificates are binding on the court. Chapter 5 Central People’s Government’s National Security Agencies in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

blocks.question: 《香港國安法》第 43 條原文：「（二）要求涉嫌實施危害國家安全犯罪行為的人員交出__________或者限制其離境；」

blocks.question: 《香港國安法》第 44 條原文：「行政長官在指定法官前可徵詢香港特別行政區維護國家__________和終審法院首席法官的意見。」

feedbackCorrect.text: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 44 條訂明：「香港特別行政區行政長官應當從裁判官、區域法院法官、高等法院原訟法庭法官、上訴法庭法官以及終審法院法官中指定若干名法官，也可從暫委或者特委法官中指定若干名法官，負責處理危害國家安全犯罪案件。行政長官在指定法官前可徵詢香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會和終審法院首席法官的意見。上述指定法官任期一年。 凡有危害國家安全言行的，不得被指定為審理危害國家安全犯罪案件的法官。在獲任指定法官期間，如有危害國家安全言行的，終止其指定法官資格。 在裁判法院、區域法院、高等法院和終審法院就危害國家安全犯罪案件提起的刑事檢控程序應當分別由各該法院的指定法官處理。」

blocks.question: 《香港國安法》第 46 條以下節錄嘅用字正唔正確？「凡律政司長發出上述證書，高等法院原訟法庭應當在沒有陪審團的情況下進行審理，並由一名法官組成審判庭。」

feedbackCorrect.text: 答案係 A。節錄將「三名法官」錯寫成「一名法官」；《香港國安法》第 46 條訂明：「對高等法院原訟法庭進行的就危害國家安全犯罪案件提起的刑事檢控程序，律政司長可基於保護國家秘密、案件具有涉外因素或者保障陪審員及其家人的人身安全等理由，發出證書指示相關訴訟毋須在有陪審團的情況下進行審理。凡律政司長發出上述證書，高等法院原訟法庭應當在沒有陪審團的情況下進行審理，並由三名法官組成審判庭。 凡律政司長發出前款規定的證書，適用於相關訴訟的香港特別行政區任何法律條文關於“陪審團”或者“陪審團的裁決”， 均應當理解為指法官或者法官作為事實裁斷者的職能。」

blocks.text: 今課總結
你已按次序完成 17 個重點嘅理解同測試。以下係今課重點：

items: 第 31 條：公司、團體等法人或者非法人組織實施本法規定的犯罪的，對該組織判處罰金
第 32 條：犯罪所得及犯罪工具須予追繳或沒收
第 33 條：自首、放棄犯罪或協助破案可獲從寬處罰
第 34 條：非永久居民犯國安罪可被驅逐出境
第 35 條：被判國安罪即喪失參選及出任公職資格
第 36 條：任何人在香港特區內實施本法規定的犯罪的，適用本法
第 37 條：香港永久居民等境外犯罪亦適用國安法
第 38 條：非永久居民境外針對香港犯罪亦適用國安法
第 39 條：本法施行以後的行為，適用本法定罪處刑
第 40 條：香港特區對本法規定的犯罪案件行使管轄權，但本法第五十五條規定的情形除外
第 41 條：香港管轄國安案件並適用本地訴訟程序
第 42 條：國安案件須從速辦理並適用特別保釋門檻
第 43 條：警務處國安部門調查危害國安案件時，可搜查相關地方及凍結犯罪相關財產
第 44 條：行政長官指定處理國安案件嘅法官
第 45 條：國安案件原則上按香港其他法律處理
第 46 條：律政司長可依法指示國安案件無陪審團審理
第 47 條：國安或國家秘密認定須取得行政長官證明書

重點包括公署喺法定特殊情況下行使管轄權嘅第 55 條機制、《香港國安法》同香港本地法律不一致時嘅適用次序，以及解釋權屬全國人大常委會。

blocks.title: 官方條文｜《香港國安法》第 48–66 條

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 48
items.textZh: 中央人民政府在香港特別行政區設立維護國家安全公署。中央人民政府駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署依法履行維護國家安全職責，行使相關權力。 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署人員由中央人民政府維護國家安全的有關機關聯合派出。
items.textEn: The Central People's Government has established the Office for the Maintenance of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. The National Security Office of the Central People's Government in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region performs its duties in safeguarding national security and exercises relevant powers in accordance with the law. The personnel of the Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region are jointly dispatched by the relevant agencies of the Central People's Government for safeguarding national security.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 49
items.textZh: 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署的職責為： （一）分析研判香港特別行政區維護國家安全形勢，就維護國家安全重大戰略和重要政策提出意見和建議： （二）監督、指導，協調、支持香港特別行政區履行維護國家安全的職責； （三）收集分析國家安全情報信息； （四）依法辦理危害國家安全犯罪案件。
items.textEn: The responsibilities of the Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region are: (1) Analyze and judge the situation of safeguarding national security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and provide opinions and suggestions on major strategies and important policies for safeguarding national security; (2) Supervise, guide, coordinate, and support the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in fulfilling its duties of safeguarding national security; (3) Collect and analyze national security intelligence information; (4) Handle cases of crimes endangering national security in accordance with the law.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 50
items.textZh: 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署應當嚴格依法履行職責，依法接受監督，不得侵害任何個人和組織的合法權益。 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署人員除須遵守全國性法律外，還應當遵守香港特別行政區法律。 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署人員依法接受國家監察機關的監督。
items.textEn: The Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall strictly perform its duties in accordance with the law, accept supervision in accordance with the law, and shall not infringe upon the legitimate rights and interests of any individual or organization. In addition to national laws, personnel of the Office for the Maintenance of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region must also abide by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Personnel of the Office for the Maintenance of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region accept the supervision of the national supervisory authorities in accordance with the law.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 51
items.textZh: 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署的經費由中央財政保障。
items.textEn: The funding for the Office for the Maintenance of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is guaranteed by the central government.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 52
items.textZh: 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署應當加強與中央人民政府駐香港特別行政區聯絡辦公室、外交部駐香港特別行政區特派員公署、中國人民解放軍駐香港部隊的工作聯繫和工作協同。
items.textEn: The Office for the Maintenance of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region should strengthen its working contacts and coordination with the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Office of the Commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and the Chinese People's Liberation Army Garrison in Hong Kong.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 53
items.textZh: 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署應當與香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會建立協調機制，監督，指導香港特別行政區維護國家安全工作。 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署的工作部門應當與香港特別行政區維護國家安全的有關機關建立協作機制，加強信息共享和行動配合。
items.textEn: The Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall establish a coordination mechanism with the Committee for Safeguarding National Security of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to supervise and guide the work of safeguarding national security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. The working departments of the Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region should establish a coordination mechanism with the relevant organs of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region for safeguarding national security to strengthen information sharing and action coordination.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 54
items.textZh: 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署、外交部駐香港特別行政區特派員公署會同香港特別行政區政府採取必要措施，加強對外國和國際組織駐香港特別行政區機構、在香港特別行政區的外國和境外非政府組織和新聞機構的管理和服務。
items.textEn: The Office of the Commissioner for the Maintenance of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, together with the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government, will take necessary measures to strengthen the management and services of foreign and international organizations in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, foreign and overseas non-governmental organizations and news organizations in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 55
items.textZh: 有以下情形之一的，經香港特別行政區政府或者駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署提出，並報中央人民政府批准，由駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署對本法規定的危害國家安全犯罪案件行使管轄權： （一）案件涉及外國或者境外勢力介入的複雜情況，香港特別行政區管轄確有困難的； （二）出現香港特別行政區政府無法有效執行本法的嚴重情況的； （三）出現國家安全面臨重大現實威脅的情況的。
items.textEn: In any of the following circumstances, upon a proposal by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government or the Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and approval by the Central People's Government, the Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall exercise jurisdiction over cases of crimes endangering national security stipulated in this Law: (1) The case involves complex situations involving the intervention of foreign countries or external forces, and it is really difficult for the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to have jurisdiction; (2) There is a serious situation in which the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government is unable to effectively implement this Law; (3) There is a situation where national security faces a major real threat.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 56
items.textZh: 根據本法第五十五條規定管轄有關危害國家安全犯罪案件時，由駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署負責立案偵查，最高人民檢察院指定有關檢察機關行使檢察權，最高人民法院指定有關法院行使審判權。
items.textEn: In accordance with the provisions of Article 55 of this Law, when cases related to crimes endangering national security are under jurisdiction, the Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is responsible for filing and investigating, the Supreme People's Procuratorate designates relevant procuratorial organs to exercise procuratorial power, and the Supreme People's Court designates relevant courts to exercise judicial power.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 57
items.textZh: 根據本法第五十五條規定管轄案件的立案偵查、審查起訴、審判和刑罰的執行等訴訟程序事宜，適用《中華人民共和國刑事訴訟法》等相關法律的規定。 根據本法第五十五條規定管轄案件時，本法第五十六條規定的執法，司法機關依法行使相關權力，其為決定採取強制措施， 偵查措施和司法裁判而簽發的法律文書在香港特別行政區具有法律效力。對於駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署依法採取的措施，有關機構、組織和個人必須遵從。
items.textEn: According to the provisions of Article 55 of this Law, the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and other relevant laws shall apply to the procedural matters such as case filing, investigation, review and prosecution, trial and execution of penalties. When jurisdiction over cases in accordance with the provisions of Article 55 of this Law and the law enforcement provided in Article 56 of this Law, the judicial authorities shall exercise relevant powers in accordance with the law, and the legal documents issued by them for the purpose of deciding to take compulsory measures, investigative measures and judicial adjudication shall have legal effect in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Relevant institutions, organizations and individuals must comply with the measures taken by the Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in accordance with the law.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 58
items.textZh: 根據本法第五十五條規定管轄案件時，犯罪嫌疑人自被駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署第一次訊問或者採取強制措施之日起，有權委託律師作為辯護人。辯護律師可以依法為犯罪嫌疑人、被告人提供法律幫助。 犯罪嫌疑人、被告人被合法拘捕後，享有儘早接受司法機關公正審判的權利。
items.textEn: When a case is under jurisdiction in accordance with the provisions of Article 55 of this Law, a criminal suspect shall have the right to entrust a lawyer as a defender from the date when he is first interrogated or taken compulsory measures by the Office for the Protection of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Defense lawyers can provide legal assistance to criminal suspects and defendants in accordance with the law. After being lawfully arrested, criminal suspects and defendants have the right to receive a fair trial by judicial organs as soon as possible.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 59
items.textZh: 根據本法第五十五條規定管轄案件時，任何人如果知道本法規定的危害國家安全犯罪案件情況，都有如實作證的義務。
items.textEn: When handling cases in accordance with the provisions of Article 55 of this Law, anyone who knows the circumstances of a case of a crime endangering national security stipulated in this Law has the obligation to testify truthfully.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 60
items.textZh: 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署及其人員依據本法執行職務的行為，不受香港特別行政區管轄。 持有駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署制發的證件或者證明文件的人員和車輛等在執行職務時不受香港特別行政區執法人員檢查、搜查和扣押。 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署及其人員享有香港特別行政區法律規定的其他權利和豁免。
items.textEn: The acts of the Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and its personnel performing their duties in accordance with this Law are not subject to the jurisdiction of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Personnel and vehicles holding certificates or certification documents issued by the Office for the Maintenance of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region are not subject to inspection, search and seizure by law enforcement officers of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region when performing their duties. The Office for the Maintenance of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and its personnel enjoy other rights and immunities provided by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 61
items.textZh: 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署依據本法規定履行職責時，香港特別行政區政府有關部門須提供必要的便利和配合，對妨礙有關執行職務的行為依法予以制止並追究責任。
items.textEn: When the Office for the Maintenance of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region performs its duties in accordance with the provisions of this Law, the relevant departments of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government must provide necessary convenience and cooperation, stop and hold accountable any behavior that hinders the performance of relevant duties in accordance with the law. Chapter 6 Supplementary Provisions

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 62
items.textZh: 香港特別行政區本地法律規定與本法不一致的，適用本法規定。
items.textEn: If the local legal provisions of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region are inconsistent with this Law, the provisions of this Law shall apply.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 63
items.textZh: 辦理本法規定的危害國家安全犯罪案件的有關執法、司法機關及其人員或者辦理其他危害國家安全犯罪案件的香港特別行政區執法、司法機關及其人員，應當對辦案過程中知悉的國家秘密、商業秘密和個人隱私予以保密。 擔任辯護人或者訴訟代理人的律師應當保守在執業活動中知悉的國家秘密、商業秘密和個人隱私。 配合辦案的有關機構、組織和個人應當對案件有關情況予以保密。
items.textEn: Relevant law enforcement and judicial agencies and their personnel handling cases of crimes endangering national security stipulated in this Law, or law enforcement and judicial agencies and their personnel of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region handling other cases of crimes endangering national security, shall keep state secrets, business secrets and personal privacy learned during the handling of the case confidential. Lawyers who serve as defenders or litigation agents shall keep state secrets, business secrets and personal privacy that they learn during their professional activities. Relevant institutions, organizations and individuals cooperating in handling the case shall keep the relevant information of the case confidential.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 64
items.textZh: 香港特別行政區適用本法時，本法規定的“有期徒刑”“無期徒刑”“沒收財產”和“罰金”分別指“監禁” “終身監禁”“充公犯罪所得”和“罰款”，“拘役”參照適用香港特別行政區相關法律規定的“監禁”“入勞役中心”“入教導所”，“管制”參照適用香港特別行政區相關法律規定的“社會服務令”“入感化院”，“吊銷執照或者營業許可證”指香港特別行政區相關法律規定的“取消註冊或者註冊豁免，或者取消牌照”。
items.textEn: When this law is applied in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the terms "fixed-term imprisonment", "life imprisonment", "property confiscation" and "fine" prescribed in this law refer to "imprisonment", "life imprisonment", "confiscation of proceeds of crime" and "fine" respectively. "Criminal detention" refers to "imprisonment", "sentence to a labor service center" and "sentence to a training center" as stipulated in the relevant laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. "Control" refers to "social detention" as stipulated in the relevant laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. "Revocation of license or business license" refers to "cancellation of registration or registration exemption, or cancellation of license" as stipulated in the relevant laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 65
items.textZh: 本法的解釋權屬於全國人民代表大會常務委員會。
items.textEn: The right to interpret this law belongs to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 66
items.textZh: 本法自公佈之日起施行。 資料截至：2021年5月由於附件條文隨時修訂或增刪，考試範圍亦會包含附件條文，建議考生瀏覽官方網頁，留意最新消息。 https://www.isd.gov.hk/nationalsecurity/chi/law.html
items.textEn: This law shall come into effect on the date of promulgation. Information as of: May 2021. Since the appendix provisions are revised or added or deleted at any time, the examination scope will also include appendix provisions. Candidates are advised to visit the official website and pay attention to the latest news. https://www.isd.gov.hk/nationalsecurity/chi/law.html

請仔細閱讀以下官方條文，留意加粗嘅關鍵規則；稍後會有測驗，檢查你對每條法例嘅理解。

blocks.title: 官方條文｜《香港國安法》第 48–66 條

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 48
items.textZh: 中央人民政府在香港特別行政區設立維護國家安全公署。中央人民政府駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署依法履行維護國家安全職責，行使相關權力。 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署人員由中央人民政府維護國家安全的有關機關聯合派出。
items.textEn: The Central People's Government has established the Office for the Maintenance of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. The National Security Office of the Central People's Government in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region performs its duties in safeguarding national security and exercises relevant powers in accordance with the law. The personnel of the Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region are jointly dispatched by the relevant agencies of the Central People's Government for safeguarding national security.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 49
items.textZh: 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署的職責為： （一）分析研判香港特別行政區維護國家安全形勢，就維護國家安全重大戰略和重要政策提出意見和建議： （二）監督、指導，協調、支持香港特別行政區履行維護國家安全的職責； （三）收集分析國家安全情報信息； （四）依法辦理危害國家安全犯罪案件。
items.textEn: The responsibilities of the Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region are: (1) Analyze and judge the situation of safeguarding national security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and provide opinions and suggestions on major strategies and important policies for safeguarding national security; (2) Supervise, guide, coordinate, and support the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in fulfilling its duties of safeguarding national security; (3) Collect and analyze national security intelligence information; (4) Handle cases of crimes endangering national security in accordance with the law.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 50
items.textZh: 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署應當嚴格依法履行職責，依法接受監督，不得侵害任何個人和組織的合法權益。 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署人員除須遵守全國性法律外，還應當遵守香港特別行政區法律。 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署人員依法接受國家監察機關的監督。
items.textEn: The Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall strictly perform its duties in accordance with the law, accept supervision in accordance with the law, and shall not infringe upon the legitimate rights and interests of any individual or organization. In addition to national laws, personnel of the Office for the Maintenance of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region must also abide by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Personnel of the Office for the Maintenance of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region accept the supervision of the national supervisory authorities in accordance with the law.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 51
items.textZh: 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署的經費由中央財政保障。
items.textEn: The funding for the Office for the Maintenance of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is guaranteed by the central government.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 52
items.textZh: 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署應當加強與中央人民政府駐香港特別行政區聯絡辦公室、外交部駐香港特別行政區特派員公署、中國人民解放軍駐香港部隊的工作聯繫和工作協同。
items.textEn: The Office for the Maintenance of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region should strengthen its working contacts and coordination with the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Office of the Commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and the Chinese People's Liberation Army Garrison in Hong Kong.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 53
items.textZh: 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署應當與香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會建立協調機制，監督，指導香港特別行政區維護國家安全工作。 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署的工作部門應當與香港特別行政區維護國家安全的有關機關建立協作機制，加強信息共享和行動配合。
items.textEn: The Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall establish a coordination mechanism with the Committee for Safeguarding National Security of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to supervise and guide the work of safeguarding national security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. The working departments of the Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region should establish a coordination mechanism with the relevant organs of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region for safeguarding national security to strengthen information sharing and action coordination.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 54
items.textZh: 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署、外交部駐香港特別行政區特派員公署會同香港特別行政區政府採取必要措施，加強對外國和國際組織駐香港特別行政區機構、在香港特別行政區的外國和境外非政府組織和新聞機構的管理和服務。
items.textEn: The Office of the Commissioner for the Maintenance of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, together with the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government, will take necessary measures to strengthen the management and services of foreign and international organizations in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, foreign and overseas non-governmental organizations and news organizations in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 55
items.textZh: 有以下情形之一的，經香港特別行政區政府或者駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署提出，並報中央人民政府批准，由駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署對本法規定的危害國家安全犯罪案件行使管轄權： （一）案件涉及外國或者境外勢力介入的複雜情況，香港特別行政區管轄確有困難的； （二）出現香港特別行政區政府無法有效執行本法的嚴重情況的； （三）出現國家安全面臨重大現實威脅的情況的。
items.textEn: In any of the following circumstances, upon a proposal by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government or the Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and approval by the Central People's Government, the Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall exercise jurisdiction over cases of crimes endangering national security stipulated in this Law: (1) The case involves complex situations involving the intervention of foreign countries or external forces, and it is really difficult for the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to have jurisdiction; (2) There is a serious situation in which the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government is unable to effectively implement this Law; (3) There is a situation where national security faces a major real threat.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 56
items.textZh: 根據本法第五十五條規定管轄有關危害國家安全犯罪案件時，由駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署負責立案偵查，最高人民檢察院指定有關檢察機關行使檢察權，最高人民法院指定有關法院行使審判權。
items.textEn: In accordance with the provisions of Article 55 of this Law, when cases related to crimes endangering national security are under jurisdiction, the Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is responsible for filing and investigating, the Supreme People's Procuratorate designates relevant procuratorial organs to exercise procuratorial power, and the Supreme People's Court designates relevant courts to exercise judicial power.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 57
items.textZh: 根據本法第五十五條規定管轄案件的立案偵查、審查起訴、審判和刑罰的執行等訴訟程序事宜，適用《中華人民共和國刑事訴訟法》等相關法律的規定。 根據本法第五十五條規定管轄案件時，本法第五十六條規定的執法，司法機關依法行使相關權力，其為決定採取強制措施， 偵查措施和司法裁判而簽發的法律文書在香港特別行政區具有法律效力。對於駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署依法採取的措施，有關機構、組織和個人必須遵從。
items.textEn: According to the provisions of Article 55 of this Law, the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and other relevant laws shall apply to the procedural matters such as case filing, investigation, review and prosecution, trial and execution of penalties. When jurisdiction over cases in accordance with the provisions of Article 55 of this Law and the law enforcement provided in Article 56 of this Law, the judicial authorities shall exercise relevant powers in accordance with the law, and the legal documents issued by them for the purpose of deciding to take compulsory measures, investigative measures and judicial adjudication shall have legal effect in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Relevant institutions, organizations and individuals must comply with the measures taken by the Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in accordance with the law.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 58
items.textZh: 根據本法第五十五條規定管轄案件時，犯罪嫌疑人自被駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署第一次訊問或者採取強制措施之日起，有權委託律師作為辯護人。辯護律師可以依法為犯罪嫌疑人、被告人提供法律幫助。 犯罪嫌疑人、被告人被合法拘捕後，享有儘早接受司法機關公正審判的權利。
items.textEn: When a case is under jurisdiction in accordance with the provisions of Article 55 of this Law, a criminal suspect shall have the right to entrust a lawyer as a defender from the date when he is first interrogated or taken compulsory measures by the Office for the Protection of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Defense lawyers can provide legal assistance to criminal suspects and defendants in accordance with the law. After being lawfully arrested, criminal suspects and defendants have the right to receive a fair trial by judicial organs as soon as possible.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 59
items.textZh: 根據本法第五十五條規定管轄案件時，任何人如果知道本法規定的危害國家安全犯罪案件情況，都有如實作證的義務。
items.textEn: When handling cases in accordance with the provisions of Article 55 of this Law, anyone who knows the circumstances of a case of a crime endangering national security stipulated in this Law has the obligation to testify truthfully.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 60
items.textZh: 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署及其人員依據本法執行職務的行為，不受香港特別行政區管轄。 持有駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署制發的證件或者證明文件的人員和車輛等在執行職務時不受香港特別行政區執法人員檢查、搜查和扣押。 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署及其人員享有香港特別行政區法律規定的其他權利和豁免。
items.textEn: The acts of the Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and its personnel performing their duties in accordance with this Law are not subject to the jurisdiction of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Personnel and vehicles holding certificates or certification documents issued by the Office for the Maintenance of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region are not subject to inspection, search and seizure by law enforcement officers of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region when performing their duties. The Office for the Maintenance of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and its personnel enjoy other rights and immunities provided by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 61
items.textZh: 駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署依據本法規定履行職責時，香港特別行政區政府有關部門須提供必要的便利和配合，對妨礙有關執行職務的行為依法予以制止並追究責任。
items.textEn: When the Office for the Maintenance of National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region performs its duties in accordance with the provisions of this Law, the relevant departments of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government must provide necessary convenience and cooperation, stop and hold accountable any behavior that hinders the performance of relevant duties in accordance with the law. Chapter 6 Supplementary Provisions

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 62
items.textZh: 香港特別行政區本地法律規定與本法不一致的，適用本法規定。
items.textEn: If the local legal provisions of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region are inconsistent with this Law, the provisions of this Law shall apply.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 63
items.textZh: 辦理本法規定的危害國家安全犯罪案件的有關執法、司法機關及其人員或者辦理其他危害國家安全犯罪案件的香港特別行政區執法、司法機關及其人員，應當對辦案過程中知悉的國家秘密、商業秘密和個人隱私予以保密。 擔任辯護人或者訴訟代理人的律師應當保守在執業活動中知悉的國家秘密、商業秘密和個人隱私。 配合辦案的有關機構、組織和個人應當對案件有關情況予以保密。
items.textEn: Relevant law enforcement and judicial agencies and their personnel handling cases of crimes endangering national security stipulated in this Law, or law enforcement and judicial agencies and their personnel of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region handling other cases of crimes endangering national security, shall keep state secrets, business secrets and personal privacy learned during the handling of the case confidential. Lawyers who serve as defenders or litigation agents shall keep state secrets, business secrets and personal privacy that they learn during their professional activities. Relevant institutions, organizations and individuals cooperating in handling the case shall keep the relevant information of the case confidential.

items.citationEn: Hong Kong National Security Law Article 64
items.textZh: 香港特別行政區適用本法時，本法規定的“有期徒刑”“無期徒刑”“沒收財產”和“罰金”分別指“監禁” “終身監禁”“充公犯罪所得”和“罰款”，“拘役”參照適用香港特別行政區相關法律規定的“監禁”“入勞役中心”“入教導所”，“管制”參照適用香港特別行政區相關法律規定的“社會服務令”“入感化院”，“吊銷執照或者營業許可證”指香港特別行政區相關法律規定的“取消註冊或者註冊豁免，或者取消牌照”。
items.textEn: When this law is applied in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the terms "fixed-term imprisonment", "life imprisonment", "property confiscation" and "fine" prescribed in this law refer to "imprisonment", "life imprisonment", "confiscation of proceeds of crime" and "fine" respectively. "Criminal detention" refers to "imprisonment", "sentence to a labor service center" and "sentence to a training center" as stipulated in the relevant laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. "Control" refers to "social detention" as stipulated in the relevant laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. "Revocation of license or business license" refers to "cancellation of registration or registration exemption, or cancellation of license" as stipulated in the relevant laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

items: 第 48 條：中央政府在香港特區設立維護國家安全公署
第 49 條：研判國安形勢、提出政策建議、收集情報同依法辦案，都屬於駐港國安公署嘅法定職責
第 50 條：國安公署須依法履職、受監督並保障合法權益
第 51 條：駐香港特區維護國家安全公署的經費由中央財政保障
第 52 條：國安公署須加強與中央駐港機構協作
第 53 條：國安公署與香港國安委建立協調機制
第 54 條：加強對外國及境外駐港機構嘅管理和服務
第 55 條：特殊情況下國安公署經中央批准行使管轄權
第 56 條：國安公署管轄案件由指定國家機關辦理
第 57 條：國安公署管轄案件適用國家刑事訴訟法律
第 58 條：國安公署管轄案件保障律師及及時審判權
第 59 條：任何人對國安公署管轄案件有如實作證義務
第 60 條：駐香港特區維護國家安全公署及其人員依據本法執行職務的行為，不受香港特區管轄
第 61 條：香港政府須為國安公署履職提供便利配合
第 62 條：香港特區本地法律規定與本法不一致的，適用本法規定
第 63 條：國安案件參與人員須依法保守相關秘密
第 64 條：國安法刑罰用語按香港法律對應解釋
第 65 條：本法的解釋權屬於全國人民代表大會常務委員會
